note: Constructed coverage fixture: fires novelty deliberately so the novelty->fractalMorph (11 presets) and novelty->feedbackDecay (oil-wheel, dark-star-drift) mappings are exercised. The primary recorded timeline never fires one — the synthetic driver sprinkles novelty at dt/22 per frame, so 20 s is a coin flip. Regenerate with: node tools/make-timeline.mjs --script tests/fixtures/timeline-novelty.script.json --summary
_events_comment: Four novelty pulses at 2 s, 7 s, 12 s and 17 s, tau 1.6 s to match the synthetic
driver's own novelty envelope (exp(-dt/1.6)). Peaks walk up to 1.0 so the mapping
range is covered at both ends rather than only in the middle: novelty->feedbackDecay
reaches Decay + 0.006 at v=1, and novelty->fractalMorph reaches BeatMorph * 1.5 and
Cells * 1.35. Stride 20 in the gate config samples frames 120, 420, 720, 1020 —
which is exactly where the pulse peaks are, so a dumped frame lands on each one.
